title: Find Me a Harpist
text: Find me someone who plays well, and bring him to me.

title: Send Me Your Son
text: Send me your son David, who is with the sheep.

title: Bread, Wine and a Goat
text: And Jesse took a donkey loaded with bread, a skin of wine, and one young goat and sent them to Saul with his son David.

title: The King's Armor-Bearer
text: … Saul loved him very much, and David became his armor-bearer.

title: Music for the King
text: … David would pick up his harp and play. Then Saul would find relief and feel better …

title: Gibeah of Saul
text: … Saul went up to his home in Gibeah of Saul.

title: A King Rejected
text: For you have rejected the word of the LORD, and He has rejected you as king over Israel.

title: Back and Forth
text: … David went back and forth from Saul to tend his father’s sheep in Bethlehem.

title: Ten Strings
text: I will sing to You a new song, O God; on a harp of ten strings I will make music to You …

title: A Troubled House
text: Surely a spirit of distress from God is tormenting you.
